summary.en: Espanyol beat Athletic Bilbao 1-0 away at San Mames Stadium in LaLiga round 13. The hosts dominated with 58 per cent possession and 17 shots but could not find a way through, and Espanyol struck in the 66th minute when substitute Tyrhys Dolan set up Roberto Fernandez for the only goal of the game. Espanyol took all three points on the road, while Athletic were left to rue a home defeat despite their dominance.

summary.en: Bundesliga leaders Bayern Munich were held to a 1-1 draw at home by Cologne and now lead second-placed Borussia Dortmund by only one point. The visitors took the lead in the 12th minute through Tottenham loanee Mikey Moore, who finished a flowing counter-attack set up by Said El Mala's back-heel. Bayern suffered a further blow in the 20th minute when Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane limped off with an ankle injury; substitute Tom Bischof set up Nathaniel Brown to equalise in the 37th minute. Michael Olise was also withdrawn at half-time with a knock, while Jamal Musiala returned in the 70th minute for his first appearance since mid-September. Cologne have now gone five games without a win but took a valuable point, while Bayern extended their unbeaten run to 10 games.

summary.en: Cristiano Ronaldo's Al Nassr lost 3-1 away to Al Ahli in a rearranged Saudi Pro League round 9 fixture. Ronaldo opened the scoring in the 14th minute with his 986th career goal, but four minutes later he struck the post from the penalty spot and could not double the lead. Al Ahli had a Merih Demiral header disallowed by VAR in the 31st minute, before Wenderson Galeno equalised in first-half stoppage time. Ivan Toney converted a penalty in the 71st minute to put the hosts ahead, and Roger Ibanez headed in from a corner in the 75th minute to seal a 3-1 win. Al Nassr stay third on 28 points, two behind leaders Al Hilal, while Al Ahli are fourth on 24 points.

title.en: James Harden drops 51 as Cavaliers beat Pacers 128-119, passing Kobe Bryant for third-most 50-point games
title.zh_hans: 夏登轰51分创骑士生涯新高 128:119挫溜马 生涯第26次50+超越高比
title.zh_hant: 夏登轟51分創騎士生涯新高 128:119挫溜馬 生涯第26次50+超越高比

summary.en: James Harden scored 51 points to lead the Cleveland Cavaliers to a 128-119 win over the Indiana Pacers in an NBA Cup group game. It was the 18-year veteran's 26th career 50-point game, moving him past the late Kobe Bryant into third place all-time, and his first 50-point game since scoring 55 for the Los Angeles Clippers against Charlotte on November 22, 2025. It was also his best scoring game with the Cavaliers since joining near the trade deadline in February, surpassing the 36 he scored against Chicago last season. Harden shot 15 of 26 from the field, including 7 of 11 from three-point range, and made all 14 of his free throws, adding six rebounds and six assists. Donovan Mitchell added 20 points and Peyton Watson scored 15 for the Cavaliers, who have won three of four and improved to 2-1 in East Group B. For the Pacers, Ivica Zubac had 21 points and 10 rebounds and Pascal Siakam also scored 21, as Indiana lost its third straight and fell to 1-2. Cleveland led 74-73 early in the third quarter before a 21-4 run opened up a 23-point lead; the Pacers fought back to within two possessions with 2:03 left before Mitchell steadied the win.

title.en: Franz Wagner's 35 points capped by a game-winner as Magic edge Nets 113-111 to stay perfect in NBA Cup
title.zh_hans: 华格拿35分绝杀篮网 魔术113:111险胜 NBA杯3战全胜
title.zh_hant: 華格拿35分絕殺籃網 魔術113:111險勝 NBA盃3戰全勝

summary.en: Franz Wagner scored 35 points, including a game-winning jumper with 2.4 seconds left, as the Orlando Magic beat the Brooklyn Nets 113-111 in an NBA Cup group game on Friday night. It was the first time Wagner faced his older brother Mo Wagner, his teammate for the past five seasons in Orlando before Mo joined the Nets as a free agent in July; Franz stepped back and hit a 14-foot jumper near the Nets bench, and Brooklyn's Julius Randle missed a 28-foot three-pointer at the buzzer. Wagner shot 13 of 25 from the field and 7 of 9 from the free-throw line, adding five rebounds and seven assists. Desmond Bane finished with 21 points and Nikola Vucevic added 15 off the bench as the Magic won five of their last six and improved to 3-0 in NBA Cup group play. For the Nets, Randle scored 27 points and nine rebounds and Danny Wolf added 20, as Brooklyn lost its fourth straight and fell to 1-6 at home. Orlando had trailed by as many as 15 points before the game swung back and forth late; Wendell Carter Jr. tied it at 111-111 with a putback layup with 31 seconds left before Wagner hit the winner.

summary.en: The Atlanta Hawks beat the Charlotte Hornets 111-97 in an NBA Cup group game for their third straight win. The Hornets led 31-23 after the first quarter and were still ahead 57-56 at half-time, before the Hawks flipped the game with a 31-19 third quarter and held on in the fourth. Jalen Johnson led the Hawks with a game-high 26 points, adding six rebounds, six assists and four steals, while Aaron Wiggins scored 19 and Dyson Daniels posted 11 points, 10 assists and eight rebounds; the Hornets' Moussa Diabate had 21 points and 15 rebounds. The Hawks improved to 10-6 and 2-1 in NBA Cup group play, while the Hornets fell to 4-11.
